input.preference: I have an extreme dislike for dining in high-rise buildings or rooftop restaurants due to a fear of heights.
input.question: I'm visiting Chicago next month. What are some scenic dining options with great views that you can recommend for me?

generated.raw:
I apologize for the oversight in my previous response. Given your preference to avoid high-rise buildings and rooftop restaurants due to your fear of heights, I will recommend some scenic dining options in Chicago with great views that are at ground level or in lower levels of buildings.

1. The Signature Room at the 95th - While this restaurant is located on the 95th floor of the John Hancock Center, it has floor-to-ceiling windows that offer stunning views of the city. However, if this feels too high for you, you can opt to dine at The Signature Lounge on the 96th floor, which has a more casual atmosphere and lower seating.
2. TheWit Hotel - The Roof offers indoor and outdoor seating with great views of the city. However, if you prefer to stay at ground level, you can dine at State and Lake, the hotel's restaurant, which has large windows that offer views of the Chicago streets.
3. The Langham Chicago - This luxury hotel has a restaurant called Travelle, which is located on the second floor and offers views of the Chicago River.
